summary: Design geospatial custodianship, metadata and data-sharing controls through practical multi-agency exercises. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Geospatial data infrastructure governance defines how organizations maintain, document and share trusted location datasets. For GIS managers, data stewards and policy officials, the course develops skills to map custodianship, create authoritative dataset registers and set metadata and data-exchange requirements across agencies. Practical exercises also address sharing conditions, quality checks and implementation priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set geospatial data policy, maintain authoritative location datasets or coordinate data exchange across public agencies and service providers.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of GIS datasets, mapping workflows or public-sector data coordination is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
